flows.title: A returning customer signs in
steps: Enter a known email and password.
flows.expect: The account home shows the customer's name and no error.

flows.title: Add an item to the cart
flows.expect: The cart shows the item once, with the chosen size and the right price.

flows.title: Check out and pay
flows.expect: A confirmation page with a single order number; the order appears once in the account.
